issues.name: Rear wing broken
issues.details: Rear wing is broken and should be replaced.

issues.name: Rear ride height too low
issues.details: Rear wheels sit very low. Check spring preload, spring condition, shock oil/leaks and free movement before adjusting ride height.

issues.name: Rear wheel alignment off
issues.details: Rear wheels are not aligned correctly. Check rear toe/camber, pivot balls, links and carriers after ride height is corrected.

issues.name: Lighting broken / wiring too tight
issues.details: Electrical lighting is completely non-functional. LED leads are very short/tight and look too fragile for reliable use. Rework the lighting wiring with proper slack, strain relief and connection checks.

issues.name: Loose power connector
issues.details: Connector in the power path between the motor and battery is weak and slides out. Inspect the motor/ESC/battery connection, secure it properly, and replace the connector or terminal if it cannot hold firmly.

issues.name: Rear suspension sits high / limited play
issues.details: Rear of Car 2 currently sits high and has little suspension play. Check spring preload, shock movement/oil, binding in the rear arms/links and whether the aftermarket setup is limiting droop.

issues.name: Short servo/receiver lead needs rework
issues.details: Aftermarket servo has a very short/tight connection to the receiver. Connection is rough and should be redone properly; possible intermittent electrical contact should be checked.

issues.name: Drivetrain clicking / bad mechanical noise
issues.details: Car is otherwise in very good condition, but the drivetrain clicks and sounds unhealthy. Open the chassis and inspect the center shaft, transmission gears, front/rear differentials, bearings and driveshaft interfaces for wear, damage, debris or excessive play before further hard use.
